reviews.title: Awesome monitor
reviews.comment: This monitor is fantastic. I went from an aging Nixeus 27" 1440p IPS LCD to an MSI MAG 27" OLED that broke within 6 hours, to this monitor, and am very happy with it. At under $500, it's a solid price given the feature list. The response times (input lag) are fantastic, and it supports 240hz adaptive refresh rate with both Gsync and Freesync. It's got HDMI and Displayport connectivity. And, it's an OLED monitor. Being an OLED means the color reproduction is fantastic and damn near 100%, so coming from an LCD you'll notice a huge boost to color contrast. Blacks will be black, not dark gray, and colors will be accurate, allowing you to notice subtle color gradients and other details you wouldn't notice before. The monitor is easy to use, with a single control knob on the underside that allows you to both turn off the monitor and go into the settings. You can change things like brightness and picture mode, as well as "peak brightness" which impacts the max brightness your screen can hit in localized spots during HDR content. Overall, works great. I will say the colors don't quite pop out as much as on the MSI MAG QD-OLED, but it's also more color accurate and easier on the eyes. Trying to read anything on the MSI had my eyes watering and they felt like they were being poked, so I guess it's sort of a gift that I had to return it and get the LG.
reviews.author: Jeffrey D. Mailhot

reviews.title: Amazing monitor
reviews.comment: I got this monitor for around 440$, for this value its absolutely amazing. Of course OLED looks fantastic but its also really smooth and has great colors. The refresh rate at this price is pretty good and the size for me works best, I've tried bigger monitors and for competitive gaming this size works way better for me so I'm not overly looking for the corners of HUD's. The menu has all the options you'd expect also and it gets plenty bright for me. Cant speak on the stand as I immediately mounted it on a desk mount. It incredibly thin, like... wayyy too thin, its super cool, but sometimes I feel like I'm gonna snap it in half moving it closer or further away. I don't think it would actually break like that just what it feels like so no big deal.
reviews.author: David

reviews.title: Excels in gaming, photo editing, and video
reviews.comment: I have used this monitor for a few days now an I am absolutely blown away by the improvement. For reference I have been using an ASUS VG248QG 165hz 1080p 24 inch monitor for a few years for gaming, photography, and media watching. Upgrading to this has been night and day. Games are much more enjoyable and often somewhat easier at a higher refresh rate, the difference between 1080p and 1440p was way bigger than I had imagined, and the colors are phenomenal. I have noticed some sub-pixel fringing on some instances of text, but it isn't a huge bother and seems like is characteristic of many OLED panels. I have really enjoyed the glossy version as my room is well-suited for lighting control on thus glare isn't an issue. I would definitely recommend this monitor for anyone who spends significant time on their computer. I purchased it at $480, but knowing what I do now it is certainly worth that and more. It felt really well built putting it together, with a nice metal stand that is adjustable. It was packed securely and came with all the needed cords for connecting it to my PC.
reviews.author: Riley Harlan

reviews.title: Gorgeous Screen - Major Upgrade
reviews.comment: This really is a top notch screen and worth the money for me if you catch it on sale, or not if you have the budget. Colors are amazing. I'm really glad I went with the glossy OLED too. Reflections aren't an issue for me and I have a light behind me and over me. This really shines on Gray Zone Warfare and Squad. I went from a 32" 1440p ips to this at 27" and I dont miss the extra space. It's gorgeous.
reviews.author: Zach Lawson

reviews.title: Great monitor, bad software
reviews.comment: This is a very well-built monitor with amazing picture and color quality.  Seriously the picture looks incredible from ANY viewing angle.  There are tons of settings for the display for comfort and picture adjustments, and you can configure the software to change the monitor settings based on what program is running. This leads into the negative - the software is just badly made.  There is an on-screen popup every time you start your computer that has to be manually closed.  Also, the app causes pretty heavy input lag on your computer any time you're switching apps, and sometimes it lasts 10-15 seconds where the computer is not responsive. The software is not necessary - you can manually adjust things from the buttons on the monitor itself, but it would be nice if they fixed the problems with the software.
reviews.author: pancakes21
